stories.title: The Missing Cat
stories.summary: A young girl's beloved cat, Whiskers, goes missing one morning. She feels very sad and puts up 'Lost Cat' posters around her neighborhood. With the help of her friends, she searches everywhere, only to find Whiskers napping peacefully in a delivery box on her own porch.
grammar_points: ではありませんでした(dewa arimasen deshita)

stories.title_ja: 新しいコミュニティガーデン
stories.title: The New Community Garden
stories.summary: A group of neighbors decides to start a community garden in an empty lot. They work together, planting vegetables and flowers. Everyone shares the tasks and enjoys the fresh produce, bringing the whole community closer.

stories.title_ja: ロボット配達ドライバー
stories.title: The Robot Delivery Driver
stories.summary: A small, friendly robot starts delivering groceries in a quiet suburban town. At first, people are surprised to see it rolling down the street. It quickly becomes a helpful and popular sight, making everyone's lives a little easier.
